rebalance_callable_by_any_caller.meaning: rebalanceFunds() can be invoked by an arbitrary caller because it has no access control modifier

custodian_is_contract.meaning: the custodian address is a contract and callback-enabled tokens may be in use

vault_undercollateralized_after_rebalanc.meaning: after a redemption via processTransfer() reduced the vault balance, an immediate rebalanceFunds() call leaves the vault temporarily under-collateralized so other redemptions might fail
vault_undercollateralized_after_rebalanc.checkpoint: after rebalanceFunds() following a processTransfer() redemption

assumptions: A prior redemption via processTransfer() reduced the vault balance before the rebalanceFunds() call.
The custodian is a malicious contract and tokens are ERC777 or callback-enabled, per assumption_custodian_contract.
rebalanceFunds() has no other guard beyond lacking access control and nonReentrant.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish that a prior processTransfer() redemption actually occurred; the under-collateralization race is stated as potential.
Report does not define the collateralization threshold or the exact balance relation that constitutes 'temporarily under-collateralized'.

limitations: The under-collateralization impact is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric collateral ratio or balance threshold.
The condition captures the general lack of access control and reentrancy guard rather than a specific attacker/victim configuration.
Reentrancy double-drain and event-spam impacts are not formalized in this plan.
